summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The WisdomTree GeoAlpha Opportunities Fund (OPPG) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the WisdomTree GeoAlpha Opportunities index. The fund is an actively managed fund that provides exposure to companies of various market capitalization from around the world based on perceived opportunities from geopolitical shifts.
